what: The modem seizes the line but never dials - observed 2026-09-07, unresolved

observed.by ear: dial tone only; no DTMF digits heard, and the operator confirmed the call never dialled
observed.ATDT9099: no result code for 60 s, then NO CARRIER (the S7 timeout)
observed.ATDT under X4: no NO DIALTONE inside 25 s - which under X4 means the modem believes it has dial tone
observed.ATDP9099: no result code in 30 s either - pulse dialling fails the same way
observed.ATI11: answers with live link diagnostics, so the DSP is responding to the supervisor
observed.AT&V: ERROR - not supported by this ID_SDL build

reading: The modem goes off hook and holds the line, and then emits nothing in either dialling mode. Tone dialling is generated by the DSP (docs/driving-the-tones.md: the supervisor's dialer folds each dial-string character to a keypad index and sends it as a mailbox tag), so a wedged DSP would explain the tone case - but pulse dialling failing the same way points at the dialer sequencer rather than tone generation alone.
what this session did that could be resp: Repeated DSP resets and downloads of foreign kernels into DSP program RAM by the takeover probes.
Several AT&T8 self-tests terminated by sending CR rather than exited cleanly.
A placement at 0x1a00 that needlessly zeroed a live firmware data block at 0x1aab-0x1ad6.
Everything above is RAM, so a power cycle clears all of it. ATZ does not - it reloads the stored profile without re-downloading the DSP.
honest caveat: This modem was never asked to dial before this session, so there is no baseline. It is not established that dialling ever worked on this unit, and the fault may predate everything here.
next: Power cycle - a cold boot re-downloads the DSP and clears every RAM change - then retry ATDT before any further probing.
